replies.author: davidbrownactor
replies.body: I think the majority of people who would enjoy my game write it off “because ai.” It incentivizes people to pretend they don’t use ai even though I wouldn’t be surprised if 99% of developers use some form of it in one way or another now. Whether they admit it or not is another thing. It’ll be accepted and understood eventually I suppose.
